title: airBNB API clone
description: A Backend API that replicates the core functionality of a booking platform (inspired by Airbnb). Users can view properties, search by location/dates, make bookings, and hosts can list properties — built to showcase end-to-end development skills.Cloudinary uploads and image handling.
challenges: Building the API in a complex format
learning: Improved understanding in API development, end-to-end connections, Authentication

title: Pneumonia Prediction Model
description: A beginner-friendly deep learning project that predicts pneumonia from Chest X-ray images. Trained on a small dataset for demonstration purposes. Uses transfer learning to improve accuracy. Integrated with a custom API (built by me) to GET and POST prediction data to the frontend.
challenges: Building the API according to the output
learning: Improved understanding in deep learning, end-to-end connections, model creation

title: Money Tracker
description: A simple personal finance web-app built with Django that allows users to track income and expenses, view summaries, and manage their financial data.
challenges: Building a full stack django app
learning: Improved understanding in Django as a full stack framework

title: Recipe App React
description: A responsive recipe-search web application built using React (via Vite) that leverages the Spoonacular API to fetch and display recipes. Perfect for exploring meals, filtering by categories/ingredients, and viewing recipe details.

title: Library Management System
description: Frontend web app to manage books, using API integration and localStorage authentication.
challenges: Handling API fetch errors and async logic
learning: Improved understanding of localStorage, modular JS structure, and DOM manipulation.

title: Student Management System
description: Full-stack CRUD app with department-wise student management.
challenges: Designing CRUD routes with Jinja templates
learning: Learned server-side rendering, SQL schema design, and data validation.
